h2: Louisiana NDT training near New Orleans: college programmes, radiation safety courses, offshore employers and online study
html:
Louisiana NDT training near New Orleans: college programmes, radiation safety courses, offshore employers and online study

Searches for "non destructive testing Louisiana" and "NDT programs near me" from New Orleans lead mostly upriver and west. The public NDT programmes we verified for this page are in Baton Rouge and Opelousas, with a radiation safety course in the River Parishes. A New Orleans candidate can attend one of those, join an offshore or plant service company that trains on the job, or take theory online and do the hands-on practical at work.

Who offers NDT training near New Orleans?

  • Baton Rouge Community College. A workforce NDT course of 649 hours over about five months, covering visual, penetrant, magnetic particle, ultrasonic and radiography inspection, with lecture and hands-on practice on each method. A high school diploma or GED is required.
  • South Louisiana Community College, Opelousas. An associate of applied science in NDT technology over four semesters and a technical diploma over three, covering penetrant, magnetic particle, radiography and ultrasonic examination plus radiation safety. The college says the training follows ASNT standards.
  • River Parishes Community College. A radiation safety combination class that prepares students for the Louisiana Department of Environmental Quality industrial radiographer examination. That is a licensing step for working with sources, not an NDT method certification.
  • Employer training. Offshore and plant service companies across south Louisiana hire entry-level staff and advance them under their written practices.
  • The local professional network. ASNT's section meeting listings show the Acadiana Section in Louisiana.

What offshore and plant employers ask for

A 2025 MISTRAS posting for a Level II NDE technician working offshore Gulf out of Houma listed three ways in: finishing a specialised NDT school programme that satisfies SNT-TC-1A in UT, radiography, MT or PT; already holding Level II in one of those methods plus a year's experience; or holding Level I with enough logged field time to step up to Level II. The job also called for offshore field duties, lifting 50 pounds, climbing ladders and stairwells, and working in heavy noise. For anyone hired into radiography, an industrial radiographer card and a 40-hour radiation safety course were required on top.

The message for a New Orleans candidate: a college or school record that shows SNT-TC-1A hours is a real entry ticket with the large service companies, and offshore work adds physical demands no course can cover.

How to choose an NDT route from New Orleans

  • Method certification or a licence? Know whether a course trains you in an NDT method or prepares you for the state radiographer exam. You may need both for radiography roles.
  • Hours that meet SNT-TC-1A. Large employers accept programme graduates only when the record shows hours by method and level.
  • Commute. Baton Rouge and Opelousas programmes mean months of travel from the city, and from Harvey or elsewhere on the West Bank the drive is longer still.
  • Who certifies. Your employer, under its written practice. A diploma is training evidence.
  • Offshore readiness. Expect the employer to add its own safety and fitness requirements before you go offshore.

Where the Atlantis route fits for New Orleans technicians

Atlantis has no classroom in New Orleans. Method theory is online, self-paced and backed by an ASNT NDT Level III, and you can enrol in any month and begin at once. Simulator practice in Practical NDT prepares you; the hands-on practical and examination then happen at your employer's facility or yard, with its equipment, under its written practice, and the employer grants the certification. For company teams, the practical sessions and examinations can run on site at your facility with an Atlantis Level III.

Offshore and plant technicians often build from ultrasonic testing training, magnetic particle testing training and penetrant testing training, after NDT Level 1 training. Gulf Coast service companies that need a written practice or exams handled can use SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up.
